name: Break a Lucky Block
desc:
Welcome to Break a Lucky Block

💤 BREAK BLOCKS AND WATCH THE CASH FLOW WHILE YOU SLEEP! 🤑

🎲 Break — Smash Lucky Blocks to unlock Brainrots, ranging from common to insanely rare!

💸 Earn — Collect stronger Brainrots, make massive money, and climb the global leaderboard!

🌈 Mutations — Some Brainrots have unique mutated forms worth way more!

💻 Play Anywhere — Works on PC, Mobile, Tablet & Console with full controller support!
